user_query: Can you help me find the district capital of Ghana with the highest population? Also, provide me with the name of the country associated with the IP address 103.255.5.26.

TaskList.description: Query the database or API for the district capitals of Ghana along with their populations.
Identify the capital with the highest population based on the data retrieved in Subtask 1.
Use an IP geolocation API to find the country associated with the IP address 103.255.5.26.
